description: Create a new day parting rule for time-of-day targeting. Ranges is an object with day names as keys and arrays of time range strings (e.g. "09:00:00-17:00:00") as values.

is_template.description: If true, shown in UI when creating/editing schedules

ranges.description: Object mapping day names (monday-sunday) to arrays of time ranges like "09:00:00-17:00:00"

use_member_timezone.description: If true, use account timezone; if false, use viewer timezone

name: create_day_parting
